description: BLK-F1: within-metal feature fusion of the D-MPNN graph representation with ECFP4, on the probe's deduplicated cohort and identical StratifiedKFold folds. Tests whether the two representations are complementary (a method contribution) or not (a theoretically-anchored negative).
unit: ROC-AUC (0-1, higher better) and paired delta vs ECFP4-only XGBoost
data_source: MetalCytoToxDB (Krasnov et al., J. Med. Chem. 2026, 69(8), 8838)
cohort: paper_funnel (Krasnov-style): build_paper_cohort(raw, metal=m) then collapse_duplicates(tie_rule=active); the Table-1 / BLK-P1 paper cohort
fold_protocol: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=split_seed); identical to the probe's within_metal and to BLK-P1.

arms.1_ecfp4_xgb: ECFP4 -> XGB (anchor; reproduces BLK-P1's XGB column)
arms.5_ecfp4_plus_dmpnn_oof_emb_xgb: [ECFP4 ⊕ supervised D-MPNN OOF embedding(256)] -> XGB (UPPER BOUND, fold-bleed)

3_ecfp4_plus_dmpnn_mlp.ci_method: t-based 95% CI (t_{.975,4}=2.776); percentile bootstrap (20000 resamples, seed 0) is reported as reference only and is anti-conservative at n=5

honest_negative.why: Ru is 64% of the deduplicated cohort, so a pooled mean is a Ru mean wearing a 5-metal label. The per-metal table is the unit.
honest_negative.arm5_is_upper_bound_only: Arm 5's OOF embeddings carry a second-order differential fold-bleed (the encoder that produced a train row's embedding trained on the outer test rows' labels); its delta must not be read as a confirmatory gain. See nested_bleed when --nested-bleed was run.
honest_negative.fallback_if_no_fusion_wins: If no confirmatory arm wins, the honest reading is that the two representations are not complementary at this scale: the D-MPNN's graph embedding adds no information beyond ECFP4, consistent with the D-MPNN being a strictly weaker scorer on every metal (BLK-P1). Reported with the ambiguity (Krogh & Vedelsby 1995) reading: the ensemble-gain term is ≈0. MEASURED, not PROJECTED.
